minori.consejo: Plural of the adjective and substantive «minore».

frases.it: Il Museo Civico è aperto dal martedì alla domenica, dalle dieci alle diciotto.
frases.es: El Museo Municipal está abierto de martes a domingo, de diez a dieciocho horas.
frases.en: The Municipal Museum is open from Tuesday to Sunday, from 10 to 18 hours.

frases.it: Il venerdì l'orario si estende e il museo chiude alle ventuno.
frases.es: Los viernes el horario se amplía y el museo cierra a las veintiuna horas.
frases.en: On Friday the schedule is extended and the museum closes at 21: 00.

frases.it: Il biglietto intero costa dodici euro, mentre quello ridotto costa sette euro.
frases.es: La entrada general cuesta doce euros, mientras que la reducida cuesta siete euros.
frases.en: The general entry costs 12 euros, while the reduced entry costs seven euros.

frases.it: L'ingresso è gratuito per i minori di diciotto anni e la prima domenica del mese.
frases.es: La entrada es gratuita para los menores de dieciocho años y el primer domingo del mes.
frases.en: The entrance is free for children under 18 years of age and on the first Sunday of the month.

frases.it: La visita guidata parte alle undici e alle quindici, ma deve essere prenotata online.
frases.es: La visita guiada sale a las once y a las quince horas, pero debe reservarse por internet.
frases.en: The guided tour leaves at 11: 00 and 15: 00, but must be booked on the Internet.

frases.it: Il lunedì l'intera struttura rimane chiusa al pubblico per interventi di manutenzione.
frases.es: Los lunes todo el recinto permanece cerrado al público por obras de mantenimiento.
frases.en: On Monday, the entire compound is closed to the public for maintenance.

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: cultural information and museum services

bloques.pregunta: What day of the week is the museum completely closed?

opciones.explicacion: The specific guide: «Il lunedì l'intera struttura rimane chiusa al pubblico per interventi di manutenzione».
On Fridays the museum opens with an extended schedule until 21: 00.

opciones.texto: The first Sunday of every month.
opciones.explicacion: On the first Sundays the entrance is free and remains open.

bloques.pregunta: How long is the opening extended on Fridays?

opciones.explicacion: The text states: «il venerdì l'orario si estende e il museo chiude alle ventuno».

opciones.texto: Until 18: 00 like the rest of the day.
opciones.explicacion: The usual closing hours at 18: 00 are extended on Fridays.

bloques.pregunta: What is the amount to be paid by a person at reduced rates?

opciones.explicacion: The text clearly indicates: «quello ridotto costa sette euro».
Twelve euros is the ordinary fee or «biglietto intero».
It is an invented price not included in the text.

bloques.pregunta: Under what circumstances can visitors access without paying entry?

opciones.texto: Children under 18 and all visitors on the first Sunday of the month.
opciones.explicacion: The standard is: «L'ingresso è gratuito per i minori di diciotto anni e la prima domenica del mese».

opciones.texto: All college students with a license on Saturdays in the afternoon.
opciones.explicacion: Free is not associated with Saturday but with the first monthly Sunday.

opciones.texto: Exclusivamente quienes contraten la visita guiada completa.
opciones.explicacion: The guided tour requires prior booking and ticket.

bloques.pregunta: What formal requirement is necessary to participate in the guided tour?

opciones.texto: Book the square previously via the Internet.
opciones.explicacion: The text warns taxatively: «ma deve essere prenotata online».

opciones.texto: To be presented in a window ten minutes earlier without prior notice.
opciones.explicacion: The reservation must be processed in a telematics manner.

opciones.texto: Adquirir únicamente la modalidad de entrada general.
opciones.explicacion: The visit is arranged by means of a prior reservation on the Internet.

bloques.pregunta: Why does the museum suspend its attention to the public on Monday?

opciones.texto: For regular maintenance of the building and the rooms.
opciones.explicacion: The text accurately indicates: «per interventi di manutenzione».

opciones.texto: For a strike called by the care staff in the room.
opciones.explicacion: It is due to technical causes of preventive maintenance.

opciones.texto: For the preparation of a new private temporary exhibition.
opciones.explicacion: The reason expressed in the text is maintenance.

bloques.frase: La visita guidata deve essere prenotata online
bloques.traduccion: The guided tour should be reserved via the Internet
bloques.explicacion: Information enunciate with passive modal verbal form.

intro: It includes information on times, rates and access modalities from a visitor guide.
